scored_image_note: The run directory calls this image set 'raw', and its experiment_config.yaml describes it as 'Original unmodified images from dataset (baseline)'. Both are a stale template label. pipeline2/utils/eval_dataset.py builds the evaluated manifest by rewriting every image_path to result/<run>/intermediate/<image_id>/final/<image_id>_final.png, so what was scored is the VeilLens output, not the original photograph. pipeline2/utils/accuracy.py, which produced accuracy_stats.txt from these same files, labels every row 'Processed' for the same reason.
raw_note: This evaluator has no unprotected baseline. It was run once, on the protected images only. The only raw-image reads of this holdout that survive at all are GPT-5's, as coordinates, for the 59-image half.
